quote: Because the Side Letter has first priority (SPA § 11.11), indemnification claims — which will be the primary post-Closing remedy (SPA § 9.8) — are governed by a different body of law and must be brought in a different forum than all other disputes under the SPA.
reason: Issue 4 identifies the conflict between Side Letter § 6 (Delaware law, Court of Chancery) and SPA §§ 11.8–11.9 (New York law, New York County courts). It explains that under the § 11.11 precedence clause the Side Letter controls, which splits the governing law and forum for indemnity claims. It also covers the client impact: risk of inconsistent frameworks and the cost of two forums. It recommends conforming Side Letter § 6 to New York law and forum.
